PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.PHASE_GATE: Phase-11 implementation gate passed locally and hosted Linux/macOS fresh-install evidence was captured on 2026-05-20
PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a stronger developer-tool beta with critical proxy transparency fixed, Unicode-safe truncation across user-facing preview paths, gain --graph implemented, stricter public-doc command/flag parity, precise installer diagnostics, candidate-ref release workflow traceability, and hosted Linux/macOS fresh-install evidence. Remaining readiness risk is concentrated in deferred Windows packaging and broader external adoption feedback.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards; 75/75 contracted files and 323 function contracts after Phase-11 changes
EVIDENCE.CI_GATE: Full scripts/ci.sh gate passes, including fmt, clippy, runtime guard, 93 tests, release candidate policy, release smoke, verify, review, refresh, and status
EVIDENCE.PHASE11_GATE: Local Phase-11 gates passed: cargo fmt --all, cargo test --all-targets with writable XDG_DATA_HOME, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, scripts/ci.sh, refresh --json drift=0, verify --ci, and review --mode full --ci
EVIDENCE.PROXY_TRANSPARENCY: syn proxy now preserves wrapped command exit status; regression tests cover nonzero exit propagation, Unicode passthrough truncation, positive token savings, and gain --graph output
EVIDENCE.UNICODE_TRUNCATION: Shared truncate_chars utility is used by proxy passthrough, TOML filters, GRACE fix snippets, CLI search/grep previews, MCP search/trace previews, and LSP parse-error previews
EVIDENCE.TOKEN_ECONOMY_TRUTH: Public token-economy claims now point users to measured local syn gain output; tests prove project-local filters can produce positive tracked savings and graph output
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_SMOKE: GitHub release run 26120421918 built Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, macOS x86_64, and macOS arm64 artifacts, aggregated SHA256SUMS, and published v2.3.5 through Node 24-ready release actions and CLI artifact download
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: Public main installer installed v2.3.5 from the Linux x86_64 release artifact with SHA256 verification; installer maps Linux/macOS x86_64 and arm64 hosts to declared prebuilt artifacts and keeps cargo source fallback
EVIDENCE.HOSTED_FRESH_INSTALL: GitHub CI run 26143369696 at commit bc2ec39267670317e1c3a6f8e9bca4462dc8b728 captured push-time public fresh-install smoke evidence: linux ubuntu-latest job 76893339171 and macos macos-latest job 76893339148 completed successfully using the public raw installer URL and temporary SYN_INSTALL_DIR
EVIDENCE.ACTIONS_RUNTIME: Hosted main CI run 26120689647 and release run 26120421918 completed with no Node.js 20, DEP0040, DEP0005, or deprecation log markers
EVIDENCE.PHASE7_GATE: Local Phase-7 hardening gate passed: 74 tests, clippy -D warnings, runtime guard, release smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full, refresh drift=0, and scripts/ci.sh
EVIDENCE.PHASE8_GATE: Local Phase-8 gates passed: docs parity, release tag guard, release smoke with packaged version assertion, cargo audit --deny warnings, all-target tests, clippy -D warnings, refresh drift=0, and verify --ci
EVIDENCE.PHASE9_GATE: Local Phase-9 gates passed: release_candidate tests, docs parity, all-target tests, clippy -D warnings, release-candidate dry-run with explicit v2.3.5 tag, release smoke, and scripts/ci.sh with verify/review
EVIDENCE.PHASE10_GATE: Local Phase-10 gates passed: support_readiness tests, release_candidate tests with GitHub Step Summary evidence, docs parity, all-target tests, clippy -D warnings, cargo audit --deny warnings, release-candidate dry-run, release smoke, and scripts/ci.sh with verify/review
EVIDENCE.DOC_TRUTH: Public README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, WORKFLOW, and SUPPORT docs are guarded against ghost CLI commands, unsupported command flags, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete synapse-ai release paths, and unsupported Windows install claims
EVIDENCE.SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: install.sh --diagnose reports independent OS and architecture support status, Linux/macOS artifact mapping, install directory status, tool availability, checksum verifier status, Windows packaging deferral, and SYN_INSTALL_DIR guidance; INSTALL, FAQ, and SUPPORT docs describe the diagnostic collection flow
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_DISCIPLINE: Release workflow rejects tag/version mismatches, publishes generated release notes, verifies SHA256SUMS, and runs release smoke for Linux/macOS artifacts
EVIDENCE.EVIDENCE_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_DISCIPLINE: Manual release-candidate workflow checks out the requested candidate ref, records commit evidence, runs dry-run gate for tag/version policy, generated release notes, checksum aggregation, installer dry-run mapping, fresh Linux/macOS install smoke automation, Step Summary evidence, and Linux/macOS release smoke coverage before release publishing
EVIDENCE.SUPPLY_CHAIN: notify updated to 8.2.0; Cargo.lock no longer includes instant; hosted CI security job enforces cargo audit --deny warnings
EVIDENCE.MCP_PROTOCOL: syn mcp keeps stdout protocol-clean and JSON-RPC notifications silent
EVIDENCE.INDEX_LIFECYCLE: Full re-index removes deleted-file search entries and syn index --no-git is covered by regression tests
EVIDENCE.BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG: syn init followed by syn doctor accepts built-in default config on clean machines, and existing OpenCode MCP siblings survive Synapse config merge

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred beyond Phase-5
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_NON_DEVELOPER_INSTALL: Non-Linux/macOS users still require source fallback or future platform artifacts
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE: Real user feedback still needs to be collected across more environments
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_TEST_FILE_SIZE_TARGET: tests/docs_parity.rs and tests/integration_test.rs exceed the 500-line Phase-2 maintainability target while remaining under the hard 1300-line gate

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Collect external adoption feedback across more Linux/macOS environments and schedule deferred Windows packaging separately
